stories.headline: US sanctions Chilean officials over proposed Chinese submarine cable, sparks diplomatic crisis
stories.summary: The US revoked visas for three Chilean officials involved in evaluating a Hong Kong-Valparaíso submarine cable project, triggering strong condemnation from the Boric government and Chinese embassy. The crisis comes as President-elect Kast prepares to take office amid US pressure to reject the Chinese project.

stories.headline: José Antonio Kast's presidential transition preparations and controversial official portrait
stories.summary: President-elect José Antonio Kast unveiled his official portrait featuring the national coat of arms on his presidential sash, sparking controversy and legal complaints. He also announced plans to live in La Moneda and made key appointments including generals Christian Bolívar and Alberto Soto.

stories.headline: Boric condemns both US-Israeli attacks on Iran and Iranian retaliation in Middle East
stories.summary: President Gabriel Boric issued balanced statements condemning both US-Israeli military operations against Iran and Iran's retaliatory missile attacks on regional countries, calling for an end to the 'cycle of barbarities' and urging respect for international law.

stories.headline: CODELCO signs strategic partnership with Rio Tinto and issues international bonds
stories.summary: State copper company CODELCO signed a memorandum of understanding with Rio Tinto for strategic collaboration on major mining projects and successfully issued $1.25 billion in international bonds. The moves are part of CODELCO's strategy to strengthen partnerships and finance investment programs.

stories.headline: Chilean Armed Forces receive honors and announce F-16 maintenance contracts
stories.summary: President Boric awarded decorations to 49 generals and admirals from the Armed Forces. Separately, BAE Systems secured contracts worth nearly $99 million to provide maintenance support for Chile's F-16 fighter fleet through 2037, strengthening the Air Force's operational capabilities.

stories.headline: Universidad de Chile defeats Colo Colo 1-0 in Superclásico at Estadio Monumental
stories.summary: In the 199th edition of Chile's football Superclásico, Universidad de Chile beat Colo Colo 1-0 at the Estadio Monumental in Santiago. The match was broadcast exclusively by TNT Sports and HBO Max, marking the fifth date of the 2026 Liga de Primera championship.

stories.headline: Chile confirms international friendlies with Portugal and FIFA Series participation
stories.summary: Chile's national football team confirmed a friendly match against Portugal on June 6, marking a reunion with Cristiano Ronaldo's team ahead of the 2026 World Cup. Chile will also participate in the FIFA Series tournament in New Zealand, facing various opponents as preparation continues despite missing World Cup qualification.
